#!/usr/bin/env python3

MASK32 = 0xFFFFFFFF
MASK64 = (1 << 64) - 1
KEY_MULT = 1234567
PLAINTEXT_DELTA = (0x00000002 << 32) | 0x00008082


def _g(a, b, x):
    temp = (a + b + x) & 0xFF
    return ((temp << 2) | (temp >> 6)) & 0xFF


def _f(value):
    x = [0] * 4
    y = [0] * 4

    for i in range(4):
        x[i] = value & 0xFF
        value >>= 8

    y[2] = _g(x[3] ^ x[2], x[1] ^ x[0], 1)
    y[3] = _g(x[3], y[2], 0)
    y[1] = _g(x[1] ^ x[0], y[2], 0)
    y[0] = _g(x[0], y[1], 1)

    output = 0
    for i in range(4):
        output |= y[i] << (8 * i)

    return output & MASK32


def attack(encrypt_fn):
    candidates = [(seed * KEY_MULT) & MASK32 for seed in range(0x10000)]
    possible = None

    for i in range(32):
        plaintext = ((i + 1) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) & MASK64
        c1 = encrypt_fn(plaintext)
        c2 = encrypt_fn(plaintext ^ PLAINTEXT_DELTA)

        r4a = ((c1 >> 32) ^ (c1 & MASK32)) & MASK32
        r4b = ((c2 >> 32) ^ (c2 & MASK32)) & MASK32
        target = 0x00008080 ^ ((c1 >> 32) ^ (c2 >> 32))

        pool = candidates if possible is None else possible
        possible = [
            k for k in pool
            if (_f(r4a ^ k) ^ _f(r4b ^ k)) == target
        ]

        if len(possible) <= 1:
            break

    return possible[0]
